name: io.github.yocoolab/yocoolab
description: Pin visual feedback on any live web page and hand it to your AI coding agent with the element, selector, screenshot and full thread attached — then get a pull request back. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code and Windsurf.

environmentVariables.name: YOCOOLAB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Yocoolab JWT, from the Chrome extension settings or app.yocoolab.com. When unset, thread feedback tools are disabled but bridge, companion and activity tools still work.

environmentVariables.name: YOCOOLAB_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Yocoolab API base URL. Defaults to https://app.yocoolab.com.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub PAT with repo scope, needed only for the PR-creation tools. Auto-detected from the gh CLI when authenticated.

environmentVariables.name: YOCOOLAB_BRIDGE_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your project workspace, used to resolve file references in selections. Defaults to the current working directory.
